safety.checkpointStrategy: Per-source-collection document-ID cursor with explicit completed checkpoint and resumable next cursor
safety.idempotencyKey: Deterministic canonical document ID per identity/relationship record
safety.retryPolicy: Retry only idempotent bounded batches; failed/unresolved records remain visible and are not silently skipped
safety.rollbackStrategy: Prefer read/write switch reversal and forward reconciliation; do not delete canonical records automatically
safety.secretsPolicy: Use managed production credentials only; never commit service-account JSON; reports omit raw IDs by default

invariantChecks: Existing users document ID adoption does not contradict uid/userId

Guardian references resolve and do not contradict primary-parent rules
School memberships resolve to both Person and Organisation sources
Deterministic target IDs do not collide across different source records
Canonical target collections are understood before write mode

legacyWriteStopCriteria: Canonical write commands cover all active identity/relationship mutations
No current workflow relies on legacy relationship write authority
Any retained compatibility mirror is one-way from canonical
retirementCriteria: No active legacy reads/writes remain for the migrated fact
Temporary migration tools/tests have explicit retirement action
